# awscc_wellarchitected_workload (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::WellArchitected::Workload



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `account_ids` (List of String) The list of Amazon Web Services account IDs associated with the workload.
- `architectural_design` (String) The URL of the architectural design for the workload.
- `aws_regions` (List of String) The list of Amazon Web Services Regions associated with the workload.
- `description` (String) The description for the workload.
- `discovery_config` (Attributes) Discovery configuration associated to the workload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discovery_config))
- `environment` (String) The environment for the workload.
- `improvement_status` (String) The improvement status for a workload.
- `industry` (String) The industry for the workload.
- `industry_type` (String) The industry type for the workload.
- `lenses` (List of String) The list of lenses associated with the workload.
- `non_aws_regions` (List of String) The list of non-Amazon Web Services Regions associated with the workload.
- `notes` (String) The notes associated with the workload.
- `review_owner` (String) The review owner of the workload.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the workload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `workload_arn` (String) The ARN for the workload.
- `workload_id` (String) The ID assigned to the workload.
- `workload_name` (String) The name of the workload.

<a id="nestedatt--discovery_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `discovery_config`

Read-Only:

- `trusted_advisor_integration_status` (String) Discovery integration status in respect to Trusted Advisor for the workload.
- `workload_resource_definition` (List of String) The mode to use for identifying resources associated with the workload.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
